title: 2.4 Range Raid
concept: BST range query [lo, hi] with subtree pruning
objective: Walk the BST for Range [30..70]: [Report Room] when in range, and [Prune Left] or [Prune Right] to grey-out subtrees outside [30..70] for bonus points!
start_status: Range Raid [30..70] at root 50: decide whether to [Report Room], [Prune Left], or [Prune Right]!
hints: If a room's key is <= lo, its left subtree is all < lo (Prune Left); if >= hi, its right subtree is all > hi (Prune Right); if lo <= key <= hi, Report it.
